notes: Like distill.json, but built from releases during the first attempt: decisions up to sim step 150 (max_step), carries of up to 4 replans (max_hold), every such release of an episode (first_only false). In the tutorial's project distill.json's rule mostly picked late releases, after many retries; this targets the failure the paper describes, letting go of the cube on the first carry. See docs/TUTORIAL.md, step 7.
